Alongside it
------------

The stack's images bring their own programs, under their own licences:
Ergo, the IRC server (MIT); guildnet-chat, the web chat, a fork of gamja
(AGPL-3.0-only); Caddy and caddy-l4 (Apache-2.0); PostgreSQL (the
PostgreSQL License); Go (BSD-3-Clause); the Docker CLI (Apache-2.0); and
their Alpine, Debian and distroless bases (various). Desks run under
gVisor (Apache-2.0), installed on the machine.

Go modules
----------

The Go modules GuildNet is built with, and their licences (from
go-licenses; .github/notice.sh makes this list):

github.com/segmentio/asm v1.2.1: MIT-0, https://github.com/segmentio/asm/blob/v1.2.1/LICENSE
